column3: gist

The auto-loaded hub boot file: boot triad, cold-orientation triad, the ordered deep read path (entries 0,1,2,2b,3,4,5), working style, capabilities essentials, task→skill routing table, precedence and session-close rules.

Narrative reference for the hooks directory — grew from a doc-routing-only page into sections on owner_review.py, read_before_write.py, change_guard.py and trigger_tools_guard.py, each carrying its measurement history and pipe-test recipes; git_state_guard.py is absent.

Advisory PreToolUse+PostToolUse hook with three checks: A kit-skill amendment warning (staged .substrate/skills), B GFM orphan-table-row detection, C post-edit verbatim-shingle hunt for un-propagated text; fail-open on every path.

The route table consumed by route_docs.py — 24 routes (20 default probe routes, 1 content route, 2 spider-swing, 1 error-review prompt route), each with id / when regexes / docs / a `says` sentence, plus a long _comment block stating the bar for adding routes.

Advisory PreToolUse Bash hook computing three git facts at the moment of the command: squash-merged-branch continuation, the tree comparison that is the real pre-force-push check, and the tracked files a `reset --hard` is about to destroy.

The Stop hook: extracts the final assistant reply from the transcript, always blocks once with a fixed provenance question, and optionally enriches it with Gemini questions (free AI Studio key first, Vertex/service-account JWT fallback); fail-open with KeyboardInterrupt/SystemExit re-raised.

Advisory PreToolUse hook that records paths named in read-tool inputs and warns when a Write/Edit describes a path never fetched; also carries two closed-vocabulary checks (Status badge tokens, PL-004 Model-line task classes) sourced live from substrate.config.json / bootstrap.py.

The doc-routing matcher for PreToolUse and UserPromptSubmit: picks the haystack per tool (prompt is a top-level key on UserPromptSubmit), matches doc-routes.json regexes once per route per session, and injects doc paths plus the `says` line as additionalContext.

The estate's only denying hook: DENIES mcp__*__delete_trigger (escape hatch FM_ALLOW_TRIGGER_DELETE=1), warns once on send_later, and warns per-command on Bash text shaped like a direct-API trigger deletion, with quoted-heredoc stripping that is skipped when an interpreter consumes the heredoc.

Repo-local Claude Code settings: 12 pre-approved mcp__github__* permissions, and hook registrations — five PreToolUse blocks (route_docs, read_before_write, git_state_guard, change_guard, trigger_tools_guard), one Stop (owner_review), one UserPromptSubmit (route_docs), one PostToolUse (change_guard).
A three-line kit-shipped skill stub: read-only investigation, produce file:line evidence plus a conclusion, name the uncertainty, change nothing.

The post-generation art pipeline: key by corner sample, despill at full resolution with the channel clamp, LANCZOS downscale to contract size, three-scale fringe audit with a zero bar, source record, in-engine verification, plus the acceptance question and four traps.

The audio member of the asset skill family: spider-swing's measured delivery contract (mono 44.1k/16-bit, sub-0dBFS with 3ms fades, mathematically continuous loops, manifest), Route A procedural generator vs Route B unmeasured AI generation, three acceptance questions and four traps.

The method for turning "can I do X" into a ledger fact: five ordered probe steps (ledger, environment, one real attempt, positive control, one-refusal-is-not-a-wall), the CAPABILITIES.md append format, and four traps that each cost a session.
